caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing male figure positioned atop a rectangular, pedestal-like base. The figure is colored in brown, red, yellow, and gray tones, suggesting painted wood. He wears a red tunic with yellow trim, a thick belt, and fitted leggings, with brown shoes and matching knee wraps. A gray cloak drapes over his left shoulder and around his body. His right arm is bent, holding a rounded object close to his chest, while his left hand rests on a staff or sword that stands vertically at his side; the staff or sword is decorated with a yellow twisted pattern. The figure has long, brown hair and a yellow band around his head. The rectangular base beneath the figure is shaded in varying dark gray and brown tones, creating a sense of depth and dimension. The background is a plain, light tan color with no additional details or objects.
title: Cigar Store Indian
